title: How House Wiring Works: From Grid to Outlet Explained
short_hook: Your charger shrinks 230 volts into 5 - here's how.
description:
Discover how does a house wiring work in this educational video. In this video:
- The service entrance and breaker box basics
- Hot, neutral, and ground wire functions
- Rectifiers and capacitors inside devices
- Voltage regulation and microcontrollers
- Safety features and real-world voltage numbers
